title: Privacy, worth doing soon: Delete all my data and Disconnect must stay reachable when the record cannot be drawn (both clients)
evidence: Done 2026-11-14 (PRs 1738, 1746): web Settings hold Delete all my data whenever a record exists (HealthTool.tsx onDelete, MyHealth.tsx delete row); iPhone's undrawn page keeps today's words and adds Settings and Sync, and its Settings sheet shows the words, Export and Delete in the same list (UndrawnRecord.swift, settingsList). US-11 AC10. Was: partial (PR 1738, web half). Was: not started. Found by the adversary on PR 1728 (H17, R1), accepted there for that PR. When a draw fails every time, the iPhone's My data shows only 'Your record did not load'. Settings (Export, Delete all my data) and Disconnect sit inside healthList (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MyDataView.swift ~:110, :121, :249; Disconnect is in ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/SyncView.swift ~:92, reached from the Sync button in recordButtons, MyDataView.swift ~:313, which top() places at ~:252), so they cannot be reached until a draw succeeds. An erase held undrawn already had this; H17 adds the cloud edit and document-save paths. Owner (Fable): a person must always be able to reach Delete all my data and Disconnect, on both clients, even when the record cannot be drawn. UI item: the design note names both clients (check the web's equivalent: the failed-first-read and unreadable-note states in widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx and MyHealth.tsx), and the owner hands the build to a free thread.
